newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 0.68 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 0.68 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was up 0.51 points, or 0.68 percent, at 76.03 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index rose 36.33 points to 3,443.5.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 14.33 percent after 15.05 percent on Friday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
